Own verdict: Sound, if scoped to #4’s explicit installation-tree prohibition/fallback, optional #5 QA distinguishing custom from upstream rules, and #3 behavioral evidence—not runtime machinery. One maturity improvement: a reusable cold-trial receipt ledger.
Gemini review: Agree targeted additions fit existing baselines; reject implying a deterministic harness is necessary or demonstrates effectiveness. Documentation coverage, behavioral results, live-provider receipts, and efficiency remain distinct.
Next: Obtain council advice; implement focused changes plus six fresh-context probes covering goal placement, denied writes, learning capture, privacy/deduplication, inherited authority, and submission verification; have a separate nonauthor record expected/observed outcomes and accept selectively staged commits before shipping.
Risk: Stop publication if unrelated dirty work cannot be isolated; six probes support only bounded behavioral claims, not cost savings or whole-project effectiveness.
